say:1:1622304001:0.text: Finally, a biped who actually understands my language!
say:1:1622304001:0.source_cn: 哎呀咕！终于有可以沟通的两脚兽了。

say:2:1622304002:0.text: Tell that fool. Daytime is my sacred nap time. I do not want to be poked, prodded, or summoned for any reason!
say:2:1622304002:0.source_cn: 麻烦你转告笨蛋帕拉塞：白天是本咕神圣的瞌睡时间，不要总...
say:2:1622304002:0.male: Tell that fool. Daytime is my sacred nap time. I do not want to be poked, prodded, or summoned for any reason!
say:2:1622304002:0.female: Tell that fool. Daytime is my sacred nap time. I do not want to be poked, prodded, or summoned for any reason!

say:3:1622304003:0.text: And another thing. He keeps ditching transfiguration class to go fishing. His spells are all over the place! Just listening to him cast makes my feathers go dull.
say:3:1622304003:0.source_cn: 更气咕的是，这家伙一上变形课就溜去钓鱼，听它说话简直云...

say:4:1622304004:0.text: Alright. What does he want this time?
say:4:1622304004:0.source_cn: 你说吧，帕拉塞想问什么？
say:4:1622304004:0.male: Alright. What does he want this time?
say:4:1622304004:0.female: Alright. What does he want this time?

choice_prompt:5:1622304004.female: Alright. What does he want this time?

say:6:1622304005:0.text: Well... I do know a little about where it might have gone. But I refuse to give that information to Pracel for free.
say:6:1622304005:0.source_cn: 唔……幻灵星游的消息嘛，我是知道一点点，但不能轻易告诉...

say:7:1622304006:0.text: Unless... he agrees to give me... uh... ten extra vacation days every month! That is my price for intel on the starglider. Ten, not nine!
say:7:1622304006:0.source_cn: 除非……他愿意每月多给本咕……嗯……十天好了，十天的假...

say:8:1622304007:0.text: Not a single day less! It's a very fair deal. And make sure he swears on something with actual value. He has fooled me more times than I can count!
say:8:1622304007:0.source_cn: 少一天都免谈！咕！怎么样，这笔交易很划算吧？还有，记得...

say:10:1622304008:0.text: So? Did it work? Can you understand whatever that noise was?
say:10:1622304008:0.source_cn: 怎么样，魔法生效了吗？你听懂它那套咕咕语了吗？
say:10:1622304008:0.male: So? Did it work? Can you understand whatever that noise was?
say:10:1622304008:0.female: So? Did it work? Can you understand whatever that noise was?

choice_prompt:11:1622304008.male: So? Did it work? Can you understand whatever that noise was?
choice_prompt:11:1622304008.female: So? Did it work? Can you understand whatever that noise was?

say:12:1622304009:0.text: Done! If it helps bring the starglider home, it can take a full year off. I will sign the paperwork myself!
say:12:1622304009:0.source_cn: 同意！只要线索有用，能帮我把幻灵星游找回来，给它放一整...

say:13:1622304012:0.text: Alright. That should satisfy Hootie! Where did my starglider go? Hopefully it wasn't swallowed by some magical river creature...
say:13:1622304012:0.source_cn: 这回能说了吧？！我的幻灵星游到底去哪儿了？该不会被魔法...

choice_prompt:14:1622304012.text: Alright. That should satisfy Hootie! Where did my starglider go? Hopefully it wasn't swallowed by some magical river creature...
choice_prompt:14:1622304012.source_cn: 这回能说了吧？！我的幻灵星游到底去哪儿了？该不会被魔法水怪给……

say:15:1622304013:0.text: Hmph. I'm keeping score, you know. I don't forget things! Mind you, it's not that I trust him. I'm just giving him one more chance. One. That's it!
say:15:1622304013:0.source_cn: 哼！本咕可是记着账呢！好啦好啦，才不是相信他，只是、只...

say:16:1622304014:0.text: That starglider moves slower than I do. It hasn't been gone long. It can't be far.
say:16:1622304014:0.source_cn: 幻灵星游那家伙，我了解它，比本咕还懒，这才多久，肯定没跑远。

say:17:1622304015:0.text: Students are always practicing bright magic around campus. That fish loves the glow. I call it light pollution, but it calls it a snack...
say:17:1622304015:0.source_cn: 而且，学院附近常有学生练习明亮的魔法，它最喜欢那些光线...

say:18:1622304016:0.text: Check <style="highlight">the rivers and lakes near the academy</style>. You'll find something!
say:18:1622304016:0.source_cn: 往<style=highlight>学院周边的河流和湖...

say:19:1622304017:0.text: Oh, and one more thing. It's been with me too long and picked up my habits!
say:19:1622304017:0.source_cn: 喔对了，那家伙跟我混久了，作息都学坏了！

say:20:1622304018:0.text: No normal fish sleeps all day at the bottom of the lake and only comes out at <style="highlight">night</style> to hunt for shiny things. That's my influence. You're welcome.

choice_prompt:21:1622304018.text: No normal fish sleeps all day at the bottom of the lake and only comes out at <style="highlight">night</style> to hunt for shiny things. That's my influence. You're welcome.
choice_prompt:21:1622304018.source_cn: 哪有鱼像它一样，白天躲在水底睡大觉，到了<style=highlight>夜晚</style>星光闪烁时才冒头，到处找亮晶晶的东西吸。

say:22:1622304019:1.text: That's too vague... Upstream or downstream? South bank or north bank?
say:22:1622304019:1.source_cn: 这……范围也太大了，具体是哪条河的上游还是下游？哪个湖...

say:23:1622304020:1.text: Does it hide in the reeds or between rocks? Ask it again... Please. I need details.
say:23:1622304020:1.source_cn: 它喜欢躲在水草底下还是石头缝里？再帮我问问……

choice_prompt:24:1622304020.text: Does it hide in the reeds or between rocks? Ask it again... Please. I need details.
choice_prompt:24:1622304020.source_cn: 它喜欢躲在水草底下还是石头缝里？再帮我问问……

say:25:1622304021:1.source_cn: 呃……好吧好吧。事情是这样的……

say:26:1622304022:1.text: A while ago, I traded a ridiculous amount of fish to this white-robed old mage in the marketplace for his ancient alchemy book.
say:26:1622304022:1.source_cn: 前阵子，我用不少鱼，就在商业街，跟一个穿白袍的老法师换...

say:27:1622304023:1.text: And in that book was a potion called <style="highlight">Startear Essence</style>!

say:28:1622304024:0.text: The book claimed a single drop could make any fish soak up nearby light and glow like starlight.
say:28:1622304024:0.source_cn: 书上说，任何鱼类，只要沾上一滴，鳞片就能吸收四周的光源...

choice_prompt:29:1622304024.text: The book claimed a single drop could make any fish soak up nearby light and glow like starlight.
choice_prompt:29:1622304024.source_cn: 书上说，任何鱼类，只要沾上一滴，鳞片就能吸收四周的光源，变得像星光一样闪烁。

say:30:1622304025:0.text: I didn't get the chance. Something unexpected happened first...
say:30:1622304025:0.source_cn: 我还没来得及试验，出了些意外……

say:31:1622304026:1.text: A few days ago, I finally gathered everything and brewed a full bottle of it.
say:31:1622304026:1.source_cn: 几天前，我好不容易凑齐材料，熬了一整瓶出来。

say:32:1622304027:1.text: I wanted the magic to settle before trying it, so I left the bottle beside the starglider's tank and went out for a quick fishing trip.
say:32:1622304027:1.source_cn: 本来是想等魔力稳定下来再试试效果，就先把瓶子放在幻灵星...

say:33:1622304028:1.text: When I got back, the bottle was gone. And so was my fish!
say:33:1622304028:1.source_cn: 等我回来时，那一整瓶星泪精华和我的幻灵星游全都不见了！

say:34:1622304029:0.text: And since Hootie spends all day with it, I'm sure the bird knows something!
say:34:1622304029:0.source_cn: 咕咕和鱼王朝夕相处，是很好的朋友，这件事肯定和它脱不了关系！

say:36:1622304031:1.text: And I'm already failing a few classes thanks to fishing. If this turns into a magical accident, the academy will definitely come after me...
say:36:1622304031:1.source_cn: 我本来就因为沉迷钓鱼挂了好几门课，这要是搞出什么魔法异...

say:40:1622304034:1.source_cn: 好的好的，那我就在附近等你！

choice:14:0:1.male: He agreed. And it felt like he meant it.

say:42:1622304010:0.text: Dura above, I swear on my title as president of the fishing club. I have never lied to it!

say:43:1622304011:0.text: If vacation is what it wants, vacation is what it gets! As long as the intel helps, it can spend an entire year doing nothing!
say:43:1622304011:0.source_cn: 咕咕是不是要假期？只要提供线索，能帮我把幻灵星游找回来...
